summary: Apply cohort analysis, holdout testing and model interpretation to customer decisions. Explore the five-day advanced analytics course.
lede: Advanced customer analytics helps CRM, marketing and sales operations professionals turn customer evidence into campaign decisions. Using CRISP-DM, participants practise checking campaign and CRM data, analysing cohorts and journeys, and designing holdout tests to measure incremental response. Exercises also cover interpreting uplift scorecards and survival-analysis outputs, then translating findings into activation recommendations and decision-focused reports using Excel and structured case datasets.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who analyse customer interactions, measure campaign response or decide how marketing and sales teams act on customer evidence.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of marketing or sales metrics and familiarity with customer, CRM or campaign data are expected. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use Excel; a working spreadsheet application and laptop are needed.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
Data science & machine learning in practice
